headline: Nərimanov district offers robust transport, healthcare, and higher education access.

tags.reason: The neighbourhood features 2.48 universities per 10,000 residents, compared to the Baku median of 0.9.
Transport index stands at 74 alongside 3 metro stations and 154 bus stops.
Commercial property prices average 4,310 AZN/m², with 12,344 total listings recorded.

summary: Nərimanov is an established district of Baku city with a population of 181,500 and a high density of 9,075 residents per km². It demonstrates strong public transport connectivity with 3 metro stations and an infrastructure index of 87 alongside a paved road share of 99.4%. Healthcare provisions are robust, showing 3.03 hospitals and 2.87 clinics per 10,000 residents. Property markets show new apartments priced at 2,722 AZN/m² and old apartments at 2,550 AZN/m² based on 12,344 listings.
